append_metrics.name: Samsung Foundry N3/N5 market share
append_metrics.description: Samsung Foundry estimated 8-12% share of leading-edge (3nm/5nm-class) foundry market in 2026; second source to TSMC with lower customer allocation and longer delivery cycles (SemiAnalysis, H1 2026)

append_metrics.name: Samsung foundry capacity (3nm/5nm equivalent)
append_metrics.description: Estimated Samsung Foundry 3nm-equivalent capacity ~12 KWPM in mid-2026, vs TSMC 50+ KWPM on leading-edge (TrendForce Q2 2026 foundry report)

node_patches.append_notes: Samsung Foundry expanded N3 production in 2024-2025 to capture allocation from TSMC-constrained customers but faces profitability and yield challenges vs TSMC dominance. Parent Samsung Electronics (005930.KS, South Korea) is diversified conglomerate; foundry is one of multiple semiconductor divisions.

append_metrics.name: EUV photomask blank market share (global)
append_metrics.description: AGC and Hoya split ~100% of global EUV photomask blank production (duopoly); AGC estimated 45-55% share in 2026 (SemiAnalysis H1 2026 mask supply report)

node_patches.append_notes: AGC and Hoya duopoly tightly constrains EUV mask blank supply; any production disruption (equipment failure, defect rate spike, capacity bottleneck) directly impacts 5nm and 3nm patterning volume. AGC 5201.T (Tokyo Stock Exchange) is publicly listed.
